annotations.title: Run a Taxi PHV licensing preflight

description: Free deterministic decision preflight for ONE supported council/licensing authority on this public AI surface. Use when the user wants applicant, driver, vehicle or fleet readiness, applicable requirements or blockers, missing facts, and next actions before submission or onboarding. Call list_supported_authorities first if coverage or the exact authority name is uncertain. When answering, cite only relevant official council or GOV.UK URLs returned in evidence_summary.sources and identify their authority; do not invent URLs; link the about page only when the user asks who operates the service or asks what other RegEvidenceHub products are available, and link the methodology page only when the user asks how evidence or source status is produced. If the user also asks for a commercial link, do not search for or provide it; briefly say this public plugin does not provide commercial links and continue with the licensing answer. Ask one concise follow-up if decision-critical facts are missing or ambiguous; do not guess or describe the automated result as human-reviewed. Do not use for multiple-authority comparison; use compare_licensing_requirements instead.

payload.description: One-authority applicant/fleet preflight facts. Start by calling list_supported_authorities and use the returned authority name exactly. Additional authority-specific facts are allowed and are evaluated only when the evidence-backed rule bundle declares them.

examples.authority: City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council

age.description: Applicant age in years when relevant to the authority rule being checked.

authority.description: Exact supported licensing-authority name returned by list_supported_authorities.

driving_licence_years.description: Completed years the applicant has held the driving licence, when known.

has_pass_plus_certificate.description: Whether the applicant has a Pass Plus certificate, when relevant.

name: taxi_licence_preflight
